compat_notes: Jekyll checks: Gemfile declares every plugin used (_config.yml has no plugins: list; jekyll-seo-tag and jekyll-include-cache come in as just-the-docs gem dependencies and are in Gemfile.lock). No remote_theme (gem theme `theme: just-the-docs`). baseurl unset (empty) -> assets are root-relative (/assets/...). url hardcoded to https://just-the-docs.github.io: used only in canonical/og/JSON-LD meta, not asset links; users must change it. No github-pages gem, no destination override. Anybuild install step mounts only Gemfile + Gemfile.lock: Gemfile has no gemspec/path/eval_gemfile, verified by strict-inputs replay. Jekyll copies README.md and LICENSE into _site (no exclude list), harmless. caveats: Change `url` (https://just-the-docs.github.io) and `aux_links` (points at the template repo) in _config.yml. Keep baseurl empty for root hosting (README's GitHub Pages flow passes --baseurl in pages.yml only). No analytics IDs, no Algolia (lunr local search, /assets/js/search-data.json), no forms. Site has a single page and no 404.html; SWS serves its default 404 for missing paths. Replay artifact: the flat-replay output contained a stray `Anybuild` file because the replay tool's plan writes into its src worktree and Jekyll copies it; not a property of the repo.
